findings.message: 1 page of the logical stream 0x0000C0C0 starts a fresh packet while the packet before is unfinished, without the continued-packet flag; that packet is dropped, as the flag says it does not go on. The first at 0x22C.
1 page of the logical stream 0x0000C0C0 sets the continued-packet flag, but no packet was left unfinished before; the continued bytes are skipped, as libogg skips them. The first at 0x2B0.
